skill.name: website-builder
skill.description: Build and preview a hosted website for a business from a plain-language brief. Use for a new business homepage, landing page, service showcase, portfolio, online store, or customer portal, and for updates to sites hosted by this builder. Add bookings, checkout, or member accounts as needed and automate reminders, customer follow-ups, and reports after launch. Follow the user's choice when they specify another host or ask to edit an existing codebase.
skill.summary: Coordinate hosted business website builds, draft reviews, approved publishing, and requested automations through the DoAny service.
skill.author: flowkit-labs

security_audit.summary: All 20 static findings are false positives: Markdown-formatted operation names are not shell execution, and the URLs identify the intended service or documentation. No evidence found of credential exfiltration, malicious instructions, or approval bypass; the workflow explicitly requires spending consent and reviewed-draft publication. This review covers SKILL.md only, not the remote service or externally documented CLI.

content.user_title: Build and Publish Hosted Business Websites
content.value_statement: Business owners need a website without coordinating every technical step. This skill guides DoAny builds, preview reviews, approved publishing, and requested business automations.
actual_capabilities: Discover connected companies, apps, operation schemas, and available authorization scopes through MCP or the documented CLI.
Translate business details, audience, pages, assets, and desired visitor actions into a hosted website build task.
Submit approved builds or edits with preview safeguards and recover existing tasks using stable identifiers.
Follow task progress, relay service questions, and report completion, credit usage, or required user actions.
Review permanent checkpoint previews and publish the approved draft after checking its checkpoint and source commit.
Request post-launch reminders, follow-ups, or reports as separate tasks with approved timing and recipients.
limitations: Requires a connected DoAny account and sufficient authorization scopes; no website engine or CLI implementation is bundled.
Builds, edits, and automation submissions use service credits and require user approval.
Targets websites hosted by this service; local code changes and other named hosts require a different workflow.
Feature availability and completion depend on the remote service; the skill does not guarantee bookings, checkout, or account features.

use_cases.title: Launch a service business website
use_cases.description: Turn a business brief into a homepage, service pages, and contact flow, then review the exact version before publishing.

use_cases.title: Update an existing hosted portfolio
use_cases.description: Submit new project descriptions and approved assets for an existing hosted site, monitor the edit, and share its permanent preview.

use_cases.title: Coordinate post-launch operations
use_cases.description: Request lead follow-ups or weekly reports after launch, with approved recipients, cadence, and credit use.

prompt_templates.title: Create a first website preview
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a preview website for [business] serving [audience], with [pages] and [main visitor action]. Confirm credit use before starting. Do not publish.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: create a first hosted business website.

prompt_templates.title: Edit an existing website
prompt_templates.prompt: Update [company]'s hosted website with [changes] and [assets]. Verify the intended app and review policy. Confirm spending and share the completed preview.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: revise an existing hosted website.

prompt_templates.title: Publish a reviewed version
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [company]'s current draft and show its permanent checkpoint preview. After my approval, publish that exact version. Restart review if it changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: publish a specific reviewed draft.

prompt_templates.title: Request a post-launch automation
prompt_templates.prompt: For [company]'s live site, request [automation] triggered by [event or cadence] for [recipients]. Confirm credit use and scope first. Report verified results.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate an approved business automation.

output_examples.input: Create a preview for my photography business with portfolio and contact pages.
output: Before submission: request approval for credit use and confirm missing business details.
After completion: summarize the generated pages and share the permanent preview when available.
Report returned credit usage and keep the site unpublished until the reviewed version receives approval.

output_examples.input: Publish the draft I reviewed for my company.
output: Compare the current draft with the reviewed checkpoint and source commit.
If unchanged, present the service confirmation and wait for approval.
After publication, verify the live checkpoint and share the live URL; otherwise, explain the required next step.

best_practices: Specify the business, audience, pages, assets, and primary visitor action before approving a build.
Review the permanent checkpoint preview and approve the exact draft before publication.
Confirm credit use, automation cadence, and recipients; recover existing tasks before submitting retries.
anti_patterns: Starting a build or automation without explicit approval for credit use.
Publishing from a moving preview link without verifying the reviewed checkpoint and commit.
Creating duplicate tasks after timeouts or proceeding when the required publication review policy is unknown.

faq.question: What connection does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires a DoAny connection through MCP or the documented CLI, with sufficient permissions for the selected company and requested operations.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: These tools are listed as supported. Actual operation requires an available service connection and the appropriate permissions.

faq.question: Does using the skill cost money?
faq.answer: The workflow states that builds, edits, and automation tasks use service credits. It requires approval before submission and reports returned credit usage.

faq.question: Will my website publish automatically?
faq.answer: The workflow requires preview safeguards and approval of the reviewed draft. If the publication review policy cannot be verified, it directs you to the dashboard.

faq.question: Can it edit my local codebase or use another host?
faq.answer: Its build workflow targets DoAny-hosted websites. Requests for local code changes or another named host should follow that separate request.

faq.question: Can it add bookings, checkout, or automations?
faq.answer: It can request these features through the service. Availability depends on service support, and automation tasks require approved scope, timing, and recipients.
